summary: the case of tests/run bootorder under etude, against an AHCI driver that takes its ports from the last to the first, a root search that looks at disk 0 alone, and a GRUB disk whose menu names the root by the node of the first disk's third partition in place of the disk's MBR id

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel && cp tools/image/mkdisk_grub.sh ${WORK}/

faults.name: ports-reversed
faults.summary: the AHCI driver takes its ports from the last to the first, so the kernel numbers the GRUB disk on port 1 disk 0

faults.name: root-on-disk0
faults.summary: the root search looks at disk 0 alone, the blank disk, so the root on disk 1 is not found

faults.name: root-by-node
faults.summary: the menu names the root /dev/disk0p3, the first disk's third partition, in place of the GRUB disk's MBR id
